import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', size='weight_grams', sizes=(20, 200), palette='deep', edgecolor='w', alpha=0.7)

# Add axis labels and title
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.title('Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type and 4K Video Capability')

# Add legend with title
scatter.legend(title='Sensor Type & 4K Video', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc=2)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
